items.text: Salary / compensation expectation (annual): never answer below $170,000 a year. If the job description posts a range X–Y, answer the value 80% of the way from X to Y (i.e. X + 0.8*(Y-X)), but at least $170,000; when a range is requested, give X+0.4*(Y-X) to X+1.2*(Y-X), raising each end to at least $170,000 and keeping the top above the bottom. Round every figure to the nearest $5,000. If no range is posted, use $175,000 for a single value, or $170,000–$210,000 for a range. This rule is for yearly salary only: an hourly-rate question is answered as an hourly rate, never with a yearly figure.

For acknowledgement / consent fields phrased as "I accept that …", "I agree …", "I certify …", or "I consent …" that expect a positive answer to proceed, answer yes / true / the affirmative option — unless the statement is something a candidate should plausibly decline.
